breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the incorrect safety criterion 'P_cr ≥ P/n = 15000 N', which is the same error present in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires 'P_cr ≥ n·P = 60000 N'. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead repeated the flawed condition from the incomplete prompt.
